source_acquisition.search_note: inventory 行为 repository_without_visual_source，候选以 github_title_search_verified 选出；PDF 首页明确给出 https://agentdataprotocol.com 而未给 GitHub 源码链接。只读 gh repo view 与 gh api README/tree 验证 neulab/agent-data-protocol 的 README 项目描述、论文/arXiv 2510.24702、项目网站和 Hugging Face 数据链接与本文标题/ADP 身份一致；递归树和严格 Figure 3 code search 未发现 plot/figure/table/visual、.tex/.tikz/.pgf/.svg 或 composite figure 文件。corpus/visual_sources/iclr-2026-fac989b896c5/ 不存在，因此所有视觉属性以 PDF 对象和 200 dpi 渲染为准。

paper_style.palette_strategy: 概念图使用浅蓝/淡黄/粉紫的角色型 pastel cards；Table 1 用 C/S/T/W 彩色缩写，Tables 3–6 用灰色 benchmark bands 与粉色 ADP rows；Figure 3/4 用 agent/condition 的橙、红、紫、蓝、绿折线。颜色主要编码角色或训练条件而非连续数值，表格其余部分保持黑白。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: Figure 1/2 的主体由 page 2/page 6 的嵌入 JPEG+soft-mask 栅格对象构成；Table 1–11 与正文为 PDF 文字/规则；Figure 3/4 在 pdfimages 清单中无栅格对象，主要是 DejaVuSans 字体、矢量线和 marker。没有公开的 editable visual source。
paper_style.style_consistency: letter 单栏版式、caption 位置、数据集/benchmark 分组和表格横线体系稳定；Figure 1/2 的 pastel diagram 与 Figure 3/4 的高饱和 chart palette 局部不共用。图表一致地缺少统计 uncertainty，主结果表复用列骨架但有效样本/domain/seed 信息未进入表头。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Overview of the Agent Data Protocol (ADP). Raw data from diverse sources such as SWE-Gym are converted into a standardized ADP format. ADP unifies data into Trajectory objects, which include two core components: Actions (API action, code action, message action) and Observations (text observation, web observation), enabling seamless integration with various agent SFT formats. Example conversions show how heterogeneous raw data is normalized for training agentic models.

color.semantic_mapping: 浅蓝表示 ADP/协议层，淡黄表示 Action/Observation 及 typed fields，粉紫表示 raw sources、对话气泡和 SFT 输出；橙/蓝箭头表示转换方向，深灰表示文字和连线。颜色与卡片形状、标签及箭头方向冗余编码。

encodings.x: 从左至右为 raw data、ADP schema、下游 harness SFT；下部例子沿同一方向转换。
encodings.y: 上部是 schema/interface 层，下部是逐条 agent interaction 与 typed object 层。
encodings.color: 淡蓝=ADP，淡黄=Action/Observation，粉紫=raw/SFT/对话；橙与蓝灰箭头区分转换方向。
encodings.shape: 圆角卡片区分 raw、typed action/observation 和 SFT；图标/气泡区分 agent、user 与 environment。
encodings.line: 实线/箭头表示 raw→ADP→SFT 及每个示例的字段映射；右侧括号表示汇入 Trajectory。
encodings.facet: 上方是类别接口，下方是 goto/HTML/Python/execution/message 的具体转换例子。
encodings.text: 直接标签给出 APIAction、CodeAction、MessageAction、TextObservation、WebObservation、Trajectory 和三个 harness。

figures.data_and_statistics: 概念性 schema/转换示意，无样本数、单位、聚合、分母、重复或误差；下部只展示示例字段与内容。
figures.evidence_relation: 引言的格式碎片化动机→§3.2 typed Trajectory/Action/Observation→§3.3 三段转换→Figure 1 方法接口；Table 2 复用 action 类做统计，Tables 3–6 检验训练结果，Appendix B 展开字段级例子。图支持接口存在和语义映射，不支持零信息损失或质量保证率。
design_strengths: schema、下游 harness 和字段级转换在一张 page-width 画布中相连。
形状、颜色、标签和方向箭头共同编码对象类型与转换路径。
caption 明确定义 Action/Observation 组件并写出标准化用途。
design_weaknesses: 下部卡片、气泡和代码字段在缩放后较小，pastel 对比度有限。
括号汇入 Trajectory 没有显示 content 顺序、validation 失败或字段损失。
主体为嵌入栅格且没有公开 composite source，无法直接复用排版。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用 raw→typed schema→多下游接口的单图骨架，并用同一实例展示字段映射；若主张 fidelity，应并列字段保留率、失败率或可验证检查点。

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: ADP collapses many-to-many conversions into a hub-and-spoke pipeline. Left: Without ADP, each of D-many datasets needs a custom Raw→SFT converter for each of A-many agentic formats (quadratic O(D × A) effort), causing duplicated code and efforts. Right: With ADP, each dataset is converted once (Raw→ADP) and each agent only requires one converter (ADP→SFT), yielding linear O(D+A) effort. New datasets or agents plug in immediately to the rest of ADP.

color.semantic_mapping: 浅蓝表示标题/ADP，中间节点为标准化数据；粉色为输入 datasets，淡黄为 agent SFT outputs，深灰为边和文字。空间位置和节点标签提供颜色冗余。

encodings.x: 左右面板均从 datasets 到 agent formats；右图增加中心 ADP hub。
encodings.y: 上到下排列 D-many input/output nodes，中心 hub 与两列节点构成拓扑层级。
encodings.color: 粉色=datasets，淡黄=SFT harness，浅蓝=ADP/title，深灰=edges/text。
encodings.shape: 圆角矩形为 endpoint，波浪形中心块为 ADP standardized data。
encodings.line: 左图多条交叉箭头表示 D×A converters，右图汇入/分叉箭头表示 D+A converters。
encodings.facet: Left: Without ADP: Quadratic Effort；Right: With ADP: Linear Effort。
encodings.text: 面板标题与 O(D × A)/O(D+A)、Raw→SFT、Raw→ADP、ADP→SFT 等直接标签给出复杂度 key。

figures.data_and_statistics: 拓扑与复杂度的概念性比较；D、A 是占位数量，未测量 edge complexity、维护时间或实际 failures。Tables 7–8 才给出 LOC proxy 和三 harness 观测。
figures.evidence_relation: §3.3 的 Raw→ADP/ADP→SFT 责任分离→Figure 2 many-to-many vs hub-and-spoke→§6.3 Tables 7–8 的 LOC accounting。图承担 efficiency mechanism，不等于对所有 dataset/harness 的实测成本。
design_strengths: 左右面板共享节点集合，交叉网络与 hub-and-spoke 差异可快速比较。
中心 ADP 节点显式承担 interlingua 角色，箭头方向清楚。
caption 同时给出复杂度表达式、转换次数和新增对象的插入规则。
design_weaknesses: 左侧交叉边拥挤，D/A 仅为占位符，无法读出真实 converter 数量。
拓扑线条不编码 converter 质量、LOC 或失败，容易把结构性结论读成实证成本。
栅格图缺少公开 source，浅色卡片在灰度/低对比输出时减弱。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用相同节点轴并排展示旧拓扑与标准化 hub，再用独立表报告实际 LOC、时间和失败率；在 caption 中明确概念计数与实测边界。

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Performance Scaling Across Agents and Benchmarks (Base vs ADP Trained)

color.semantic_mapping: ADP-trained 三条线以橙/红/紫表示 SWE-Agent/OpenHands/AgentLab；base 三条线以蓝/绿/橙表示相应 agent；浅灰为网格，黑/白为轴、文字和背景。marker、上下两个 legend、agent 名称及 direct percentage labels 提供冗余，但橙色在两个条件中复用。

encodings.color: ADP-trained 与 base 的 agent/benchmark series 颜色；上下 legend 区分 training condition。
encodings.line: 六条 series 均为 solid；颜色与 marker 共同编码 agent/condition。
encodings.facet: 单 panel 内分成 ADP-Trained Models 和 Base Models 两个 legend groups。
encodings.text: 每个点直接标注 percentage，轴标题、legend 和 benchmark 名称补充语义。

figures.data_and_statistics: 从 Tables 3–5 读取 7B/14B/32B 的 point accuracy：ADP-trained SWE-Agent 20.2/34.4/40.3、OpenHands 20.4/30.6/36.8、AgentLab 21.0/22.2/22.9；base 分别为 0.4/2.0/2.2、2.8/5.8/10.6、4.5/5.5/10.9。无 denominator、seed/run count、误差、失败值或训练样本量。
figures.evidence_relation: Tables 3–5 的跨尺度 accuracy→Appendix D Figure 3 scale visualization→正文 §6.1 的 model-size/ADP boost 叙述；Figure 4 将同一数据重写为 delta。图是补充趋势证据，不替代主表条件和评测协议。
design_strengths: 六条曲线在一个坐标系中同时展示 ADP/base 与三种 harness，便于核对 scale pattern。
marker、legend 和 direct labels 保留了每个点的 agent identity 与原始百分比。
PDF 矢量文字/路径在放大时可读性优于 Figure 1/2 的栅格主体。
design_weaknesses: 双 legend、六条线和 18 个 direct labels 造成拥挤。
7/14/32B 等距绘制，视觉上不是按真实参数量比例。
caption 没有定义 series、domain filtering 或 aggregation，且同一橙色跨条件复用。
figures.reusable_pattern: 固定 marker 表示 agent、固定颜色/legend 表示训练条件，并用 direct labels 保留关键点；对 model-size chart 明确 categorical/continuous x 语义并报告 uncertainty。

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4: Performance Gains Across Agents and Benchmarks.

color.semantic_mapping: 橙/红/紫分别表示 SWE-Agent/OpenHands/AgentLab 的 ADP-minus-base delta；灰色为网格，黑色为轴/文字。marker 和 direct labels 提供冗余。

encodings.y: Delta Between Base and ADP-Trained Performances (%)，linear 0–45。
encodings.shape: circle、square、triangle 与三种 agent 对应。
encodings.line: 三条 delta series 均为 solid line。
encodings.facet: 单 panel；legend 仅按 agent 列出三条 series。

figures.data_and_statistics: 每个点为对应 ADP accuracy 减 base accuracy 的单次 point difference：SWE-Agent 19.8/32.4/38.1，OpenHands 17.6/24.8/26.2，AgentLab 16.5/16.7/12.0。无不确定性、重复运行、benchmark denominator 或 domain-filter information。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 3/Tables 3–5 的 matched base/ADP pairs→Figure 4 的 delta 重编码→§6.1 的 consistent boost 解释。AgentLab 32B 的 delta 下降说明折线不能单独证明所有 series monotonic。
design_strengths: 比 Figure 3 更聚焦地显示 treatment difference，纵轴直接写出比较对象。
agent marker/color 与 Figure 3 对齐，9 个标签便于回查表格 gain。
矢量折线在附录中提供紧凑的 scale summary。
design_weaknesses: delta 的 reference condition 和 subtraction 未写入 caption。
离散的三个 model sizes 用连续折线连接，可能暗示未检验的中间趋势。
无 error/seed/有效样本量，且 32B AgentLab 下行与正文泛化叙述存在边界。
figures.reusable_pattern: 将原始性能与 matched delta 分为相邻图，并复用 agent marker/color；delta caption 应写明 reference、聚合规则和不能外推的非单调点。

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: Overview of Existing Agent Training Datasets. C=Coding, S=Software Engineering, T=API/Tool Use, W=Web Browsing.

tables.uncertainty: Point source counts only; no uncertainty, deduplication rate, effective training count, or quality/failure field.
tables.data_and_statistics: 13 dataset rows list Variety (C/S/T/W), approximate Count, Source (synthetic/manual/rollout) and a short Note; counts range from 0.2K to 1046.1K and mix K notation with one decimal.
tables.evidence_relation: Related-work data heterogeneity→Table 1 source/variety map→§5.1 13-dataset pool→Appendix C sampling and Table 7 converter LOC. It establishes coverage, not data quality or downstream utility.
design_strengths: Five stable columns combine task coverage, raw scale, creation source and note.
Caption defines all four variety abbreviations and the colored key is visible in the table.
Dataset names can be reused as the row axis in later sampling/cost analyses.
design_weaknesses: C/S/T/W is coarse and composite CTW is not expanded into per-task proportions.
Raw Count is not effective training scale after sampling/domain filtering.
Colored letters lose contrast in grayscale and no selection, license or leakage field is present.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a compact dataset | variety | raw count | source | note inventory, then add effective count and filtering status before using it as experimental evidence.

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2: Dataset Stats and Trajectory Analysis. A=APIAction, C=CodeAction, M=MessageAction.

tables.uncertainty: Descriptive point summaries only; no dispersion, denominator, repeated run, missingness or uncertainty is reported.
tables.data_and_statistics: Rows are 13 standardized datasets plus Overall; columns are Avg. Rounds, % Actions (A/C/M) and % Func Thought. Overall is 10.1 rounds, 53/24/23 action shares and 83.8 function-thought coverage; percentages are shown to integers and rounds/coverage to one decimal.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 1's Action classes→§4 cross-dataset analysis→Table 2 descriptive comparison; the same schema fields support the later training pool and Tables 3–6. Overall weighting and quality inference are not identified.
design_strengths: Short column set makes trajectory length, action composition and thought coverage scannable.
Overall row places a cross-source summary beside source heterogeneity.
Caption defines A/C/M rather than relying only on surrounding prose.
design_weaknesses: Function-thought denominator and missing-value handling are absent from the header.
Overall aggregation rule is not visible, and the temporary right-side layout interrupts reading order.
Descriptive differences do not establish utility or data quality.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a schema-derived descriptive table with stable length/action/reasoning columns, but state denominator and aggregation beside the table.

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3: Comparison of SOTA and our Best 7–8B ADP-trained agents’ results across benchmarks. Shaded rows are our ADP-tuned models. Other rows are collected from previous works.

tables.uncertainty: Accuracy and parenthesized gains are point estimates to one decimal; no seed count, SD/SE, interval, benchmark denominator, failure count or multi-run aggregation.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four benchmark groups (SWE-Bench Verified, WebArena, AgentBench OS, GAIA) contain 20 result rows across prior work, base, task-specific and ADP conditions. ADP rows include 20.2% SWE-Agent, 20.4% OpenHands SWE-Bench, 21.0% AgentLab WebArena, 27.1% AgentBench OS and 9.1% GAIA.
tables.evidence_relation: §5 harness/benchmark setup→Table 3 7–8B main comparison→Tables 4–5 model-scale extension→Figures 3–4 scaling/delta. Mixed prior-work protocols and missing uncertainty limit SOTA comparability.
design_strengths: Agent | Model | Training Data | Accuracy keeps comparison variables on one row.
Gray benchmark bands, pink ADP rows and gain text give multiple scan cues.
Prior/base/ADP values are visible without extracting a separate plot.
design_weaknesses: Prior-work models and evaluation conditions are heterogeneous but share one surface.
Gain reference is not defined in the caption, and no effective data/domain field is shown.
Small type and vertical dividers create density without adding uncertainty information.
tables.reusable_pattern: Keep a fixed benchmark-banded comparison skeleton, but include reference condition, denominator, seed structure and effective training domain in the table or note.

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4: Comparison of SOTA and our Best 13–14B ADP-trained agents’ results across benchmarks. Shaded rows are our ADP-tuned models. Other rows are collected from previous works.

tables.uncertainty: Accuracy/gain point estimates to one decimal; no repeated-run, error, denominator, training budget, domain filter or failure values.
tables.data_and_statistics: Three benchmark groups contain 12 rows: SWE-Bench (SWE-Agent and OpenHands), WebArena (AgentLab) and AgentBench OS (AgentLM/OpenHands). ADP entries are 34.4% SWE-Agent, 30.6% OpenHands, 22.2% AgentLab and 20.8% OpenHands AgentBench OS.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 3's 7–8B surface→Table 4 intermediate scale→Table 5 32B scale; Figure 3 reuses these 14B points. The table supports matched model/harness comparisons but not a full scale law.
design_strengths: Identical columns, row order and shading make vertical model-scale comparison easy.
Benchmark grouping preserves the paper's task story while keeping conditions visible.
ADP gains can be checked directly against base rows.
design_weaknesses: 13–14B heading merges distinct parameter labels and no effective data scale is shown.
Prior-work cells make cross-condition visual ranking stronger than the experimental design warrants.
Caption omits gain definition and uncertainty.
tables.reusable_pattern: Repeat an identical table family for model scales, but expose exact model, sample/domain condition and uncertainty so scale comparisons remain interpretable.

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5: Comparison of SOTA and our Best 32B ADP-trained agents’ results across benchmarks. Shaded rows are our ADP-tuned models. Other rows are collected from previous works.

tables.uncertainty: Accuracy/gain point estimates to one decimal; no seed/run structure, uncertainty, denominator, compute, domain filter or failure counts.
tables.data_and_statistics: Three benchmark groups contain 12 rows. ADP results are 40.3% SWE-Agent and 36.8% OpenHands on SWE-Bench, 22.9% AgentLab on WebArena, and 34.7% OpenHands on AgentBench OS; prior/base rows remain in the same benchmark groups.
tables.evidence_relation: Tables 3–4 model-scale sequence→Table 5 largest-scale result→Figure 3 performance curves and Figure 4 deltas. The row matrix supports base-vs-ADP claims but does not close statistical or protocol comparability.
design_strengths: Completes the repeated scale family and makes every ADP/base pair visible.
Pink shading and parenthesized gains direct attention to ADP rows.
Shared benchmark order supports fast cross-table checking.
design_weaknesses: AgentBench OS places a 70B prior AgentLM beside a 32B OpenHands row.
Caption does not define gain baseline, and the table has no sample/seed/failure metadata.
Visual repetition can suggest monotonicity even when benchmark-specific accuracy patterns differ.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use the repeated matrix for scale reporting while marking parameter size, prior-work provenance, evaluation protocol and non-monotonic exceptions explicitly.

tables.label: Table 6

caption.text: Table 6: Cross-task transfer with diverse vs. task-specific data. For each benchmark, we compare the same harness+model under task-specific “only” tuning and training on ADP corpus.

tables.uncertainty: Accuracy point estimates to one decimal; no error, seed count, denominator or multiple-comparison procedure. Approximate data-scale matching is only expanded in Table 10.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four benchmark groups contain 11 rows: SWE-Bench has five OpenHands/Qwen rows, WebArena two AgentLab rows, AgentBench OS two OpenHands/Qwen-3 rows, and GAIA two OpenHands rows. ADP values 10.4%, 16.6%, 20.1%, 25.7% and 9.1% are highlighted/bolded against task-specific values.
tables.evidence_relation: §6.2 data-diversity question→Table 6 matched harness+model intervention→Appendix C sampling/domain filtering→Table 10 equal-scale control. The prose names Base(no tuning), but no Base rows appear, so negative transfer is not identified from this table.
design_strengths: Matched Agent/Model/Training Data/Accuracy rows make the mixture intervention concrete.
ADP emphasis and shared benchmark bands make local improvements easy to find.
The table includes both coding and web task transfer in one compact surface.
design_weaknesses: All body rows are pink, weakening the distinction between task-only and ADP conditions.
Base is invoked in prose but absent from the table; below-base effects cannot be checked.
Mixed Qwen-2.5/Qwen-3 and unequal sample conditions remain bundled.
tables.reusable_pattern: For mixture ablations retain Base, task-specific and mixed conditions with effective sample count and domain filter in the same table.

tables.label: Table 7

caption.text: Table 7: LOC for converting datasets to ADP.

tables.uncertainty: LOC are deterministic counts, not repeated measurements; no time, maintainer, test coverage, conversion failures or uncertainty. Footnote excludes prompt text.
tables.data_and_statistics: Thirteen dataset converter rows plus Total=4892 list Raw→ADP converter LOC; AgentInstruct is approximately 1500 and remaining entries are integers.
tables.evidence_relation: §6.3 Table 7→sum of Raw→ADP inputs→A=100 no-ADP proxy calculation; Figure 2 supplies the quadratic topology. It is integration-cost accounting, not training compute or measured engineering time.
design_strengths: Small two-column surface keeps per-dataset inputs and total visible.
Total directly supports the adjacent cost equation.
Dataset row names can be reconciled with Table 1.
design_weaknesses: Caption does not state the Raw→SFT proxy assumption or prompt exclusion.
A=100 extrapolation and only 13 observed converters are not visible in the table.
Approximate and exact LOC values share one column without a precision key.
tables.reusable_pattern: Pair per-source LOC with a clear counting rule, proxy boundary, observed sample size and extrapolation variable.

tables.label: Table 8
tables.uncertainty: Four deterministic LOC entries (three harnesses plus Average); no uncertainty, time, quality, maintenance or failure count; average is based on three harnesses.
tables.data_and_statistics: OpenHands CodeActAgent≈150, SWE-Agent≈50, AgentLab≈30 and Average≈77 are listed in two columns (Agent Harness, Total LOC).
tables.evidence_relation: §6.3 downstream conversion cost→Table 8 average≈77→Cost_ADP(A,D)≈4892+77×100=12592; Table 7 supplies the other term and Figure 2 the topology. It does not measure model training cost.
design_strengths: The same two-column grammar as Table 7 makes the downstream interface cost explicit.
Average row gives a compact input to the adjacent formula.
Harness names align with Figure 1/2 outputs.
design_weaknesses: Average uses only three harnesses and has no weighting rule.
Caption omits converter scope, prompt exclusion and A=100 connection.
Approximate LOC is easily overread as wall-clock effort.
tables.reusable_pattern: List interface-level conversion cost with observed harness count, averaging rule and a direct link to total-cost assumptions.

tables.label: Table 9

caption.text: Table 9: Per-dataset sampling multipliers w_d. w_d < 1 indicates downsampling; w_d > 1 indicates upsampling.

tables.uncertainty: Multiplier configuration is deterministic as printed, but seed value, repeated runs, sampling variance and effective counts are not reported.
tables.data_and_statistics: Eighteen dataset-slice rows list `w_d` and Direction: up values include 2 and 3, neutral values 1, down values 0.1, 0.2, 0.01 and 0.001; precision ranges from 0 to 3 decimal places.
tables.evidence_relation: Appendix C resampling→Table 9 multiplier recipe→Appendix C.1 non-web/web domain filters→Tables 3–6 effective training conditions. The table explains configuration but cannot alone reproduce 30K/20K without raw counts and seed.
design_strengths: Source, multiplier and direction are aligned in one compact list.
Caption defines the sign/direction interpretation of `w_d`.
The same source family can be compared with Table 1 and license Table 11.
design_weaknesses: Dataset slices do not map one-to-one to Table 1 rows and no domain column is present.
Mixed precision lacks a consistent display rule and effective sample count is absent.
The domain filtering that changes claim scope is in surrounding prose, not this table.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use source | multiplier | direction as a minimal mixture table, then add domain, effective count and seed information when it drives causal interpretation.

tables.label: Table 10

caption.text: Table 10: Equal-scale comparison of Qwen-3-8B trained on SWE-smith vs. ADP, evaluated on SWE-Bench with the OpenHands harness.

tables.uncertainty: Two single point estimates; no seed, uncertainty, denominator, replacement count or failure values. Data Scale is approximate ≈30K.
tables.data_and_statistics: Two rows hold Qwen-3-8B/OpenHands/SWE-Bench fixed and compare SWE-smith (up-sampled) 11.0% with ADP 16.6%, both ≈30K in Data Scale.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 6 Qwen-3-8B transfer comparison→Appendix E equal-scale control→ADP diversity/unified structure interpretation. Diversity, domain filtering, source content and conversion fidelity remain bundled.
design_strengths: Four columns put model, data intervention, scale and outcome on one decision surface.
Approximate sample matching is visible rather than hidden in prose.
ADP accuracy bolding makes the local contrast easy to verify.
design_weaknesses: Only two rows are shown; Base(no tuning) and repeated-run structure are absent.
≈30K does not establish token, trajectory, epoch or compute equality.
Caption omits sampling replacement and effective-domain composition.
tables.reusable_pattern: For a mechanism control use model | training data | effective scale | metric and include Base, single-domain and mixed conditions with uncertainty.

tables.label: Table 11

caption.text: Table 11: Licensing information for datasets used in ADP

tables.uncertainty: Not a statistical table; licenses are point-in-time metadata and have no uncertainty. No retrieval date, commit/tag or versioned link is provided.
tables.data_and_statistics: Thirteen dataset rows have Dataset, License and Link columns, covering Apache 2.0, MIT, CC BY 4.0, CDLA-Permissive-2.0 and CC BY-SA 4.0; repository paths are text links.
tables.evidence_relation: Appendix F license scope→Table 11 dataset/link traceability→reproducibility and downstream-use boundary. It supports artifact reuse claims, not model efficacy.
design_strengths: Dataset axis matches Table 1 and makes license/link lookup direct.
Three columns are sufficient for a compact downstream-use reference.
The surrounding guidelines state that current licenses must be rechecked.
design_weaknesses: Links have no commit/tag/date and may drift after publication.
Caption does not define license scope or research/commercial restrictions.
Long repository paths are dense at page scale and no license source snapshot is preserved.
tables.reusable_pattern: Keep a license table on the same dataset axis, but record retrieval date/version and state which artifacts each license covers.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 建立 raw→ADP→SFT 方法接口，Table 1 给出 13-source 数据池，Figure 2 将接口转成 many-to-many→hub-and-spoke 机制，Table 2 给出 schema-derived heterogeneity，Tables 3–5 展开 accuracy，Table 6 做 mixture ablation，Tables 7–8 量化 LOC，Appendix Table 9/Figures 3–4/Table 10 补充 sampling、scale/delta 和 equal-scale，Table 11 收束 license/reuse 边界。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure 2 和 Table 6 caption 写出结构/比较主句；Figure 1、Tables 1–5、Figures 3–4、Tables 7–11 多数只写标题、设置或编码 key，主发现、delta 定义、denominator、seed 和 uncertainty 留给正文或附录段落。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1/2 用 dataset 与 ADP schema statistics；Tables 3–6 共享 Agent | Model | Training Data | Accuracy 并用 benchmark bands 分组；Tables 7–8 用 converter/cost 两列；Table 9 用 source/multiplier/direction；Table 10 用 model/data/scale/accuracy；Table 11 用 dataset/license/link。effective sample/domain/seed 不在公共 header。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1 的 Action/Observation schema→Figure 2 的 conversion topology→Table 2 的跨数据集描述→Tables 3–5 的 efficacy→Table 6 的 diverse-vs-task-specific intervention；Table 10 只对一组做 equal-scale control，Tables 7–8 处理集成 LOC 而非训练 compute。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文保留 schema、数据池、harness、benchmark、accuracy、mixture 和 LOC；Appendix B 给字段级 listing，Appendix C 给 multiplier/domain filtering，Appendix D 重绘 scale/delta，Appendix E 给 Table 10，Appendix F 给 Table 11。Appendix C.1 的 non-web/web harness filtering 是改变 cross-domain interpretation 的实质边界。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文/表格以 Nimbus Roman No9 L 与 Computer Modern 数学体为主，代码/模型字段混用 NimbusMonL；Figure 3/4 以 DejaVuSans/DejaVuSans-Bold 图内标注，Figure 1/2 为嵌入 sans-serif raster labels。表格字号与图内 label 均偏小，但对象族内保持稳定。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Tables 3–6 的灰色 benchmark band/粉色 ADP row 语义稳定，Figure 3/4 的 agent marker/color 也跨图复用；Figure 1/2 的 pastel role palette 只在概念图内一致，和定量图不共享全局颜色。直接标签、形状和空间位置提供部分冗余，但 pastel 与红绿/橙绿组合的灰度/色觉安全性有限。

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 1 的 raw→typed schema→多 agent interface 入口，把抽象 protocol 与字段级实例放在同一画布。
Figure 2 的相同节点轴 many-to-many/hub-and-spoke 对照，并将概念复杂度与后续 LOC 表分开。
Tables 3–6 复用 Agent | Model | Training Data | Accuracy 骨架，以 benchmark bands 与 ADP shading 保持跨对象可核对。
Figure 3/4 用一致 marker/color 将原始性能与 matched delta 相邻表达，Table 10 把 equal-scale mechanism control 压缩为四列。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：最清楚的方法接口与 ADP 字段语义入口。
Figure 2：结构性 converter 成本机制的 topology 对照。
Tables 3–5：跨 harness、benchmark 和 model scale 的主结果矩阵。
Table 6 与 Table 10：diverse-vs-task-specific 及 data-volume alternative 的最小消融链。
failure_patterns: 除少数定性声明外，图表普遍缺少 denominator、seed/run count、失败值和统计 uncertainty。
Figure 3/4 caption 未定义 series/delta，Table 7/8 caption 未定义 LOC proxy、prompt exclusion 和外推边界。
Table 6 正文引入 Base(no tuning) 但表中没有 Base 行，无法从对象本身识别 below-base negative transfer。
Appendix C.1 显示 OpenHands/SWE-Agent 只用 non-web、AgentLab 只用 web，收窄正文 cross-domain/no-domain-specific-tuning 解释；Figure 1/2 又没有可复用公开视觉源。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文先用统一 schema 与 conversion topology 建立方法主线，再用稳定的 benchmark 表头、scale/delta 折线、mixture/equal-scale 对照和 license 表把互操作性、性能、成本与适用边界逐层映射到可检查对象。
